reason: The old kubectl auth can-i create pods/exec query treated exec as a resource name instead of the exec subresource. It did not prove either GET or CREATE denial on an actual workload Pod.
current_contract: The later T6/T12 cutover access is an explicit opt-in Role granting exec to named Pods. A blanket baseline denial probe must report this grant, not PASS. Historical evidence and current cutover-access verification are separate.
